h1: Le Blocs Aranyaprathet — A Modern Shipping-Container Stay with a Cafe Near Rong Kluea Market
intro: If you want a distinctive place to overnight before crossing the border or shopping at Rong Kluea Market, Le Blocs Resort & Cafe is a stay where the whole property — around 14 rooms — is built from shipping containers, in the Aranyaprathet area · What travellers like most is the modern, clean rooms that feel far roomier than most people expect from a container, plus an on-site cafe, free parking and free Wi-Fi in every room · It sits about 3-4 km from Rong Kluea Market and the Ban Khlong Luek border, a short drive away · Rooms start from about ฿750/night, a budget pick that suits border crossers, market shoppers and anyone who wants to try a design-led stay without paying much.

body.html: Le Blocs Resort & Cafe is at 87 KM.2 Left Side Rd, Aranyaprathet Subdistrict, Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo Province — in the Aranyaprathet area, close to Rong Kluea Market and the Ban Khlong Luek crossing into Poipet on the Cambodian side · What sets it apart from other stays in the area is that the entire resort is built from shipping containers — around 14 rooms finished in bright, contemporary tones. Several reviewers describe stumbling onto it almost by accident while walking toward the border.

The recurring praise is for the clean rooms and a modern look that punches above the price · Many travellers worry a container room will feel cramped or hot, but most reviews say the rooms are larger than expected, the air-con is cold, the bathroom has a proper shower, and everything is laid out sensibly · There's free Wi-Fi in every room, bottled water, luggage storage and non-smoking rooms · The overall feel is quiet and easy — ideal for a one-night stop before moving on.

"Found it by chance walking to the border. The room was modern and spotless — I never expected a shipping container to be this comfortable. Staff even helped order a tuk-tuk into town. Great value for a stay near the border."

There's an on-site cafe and restaurant for a coffee or a light bite, which is handy because outside options in this area aren't right next door · Free parking makes it easy for self-drivers, and the location sits between the town and the border market, so it's a quick ride to either Rong Kluea Market or the town centre · Staff happily arrange a local tuk-tuk and give clear border-crossing advice — something foreign visitors mention often.

To be straight about the trade-offs — there is no breakfast service, so you'll sort that yourself at the on-site cafe or in town · It's a small property with no pool or gym like a larger hotel; the focus is a clean, design-led bed rather than a full set of facilities · And because the rooms are containers, some guests note the walls don't block sound as well as concrete — if you're sensitive to noise, ask for an interior room.

In short, Le Blocs Aranyaprathet suits shoppers heading to Rong Kluea Market, travellers crossing into Poipet, or anyone who wants a budget container-design stay that isn't like everywhere else · The overall score of around 8.6 from real reviews reflects it well — clean, modern rooms, an on-site cafe, free parking and helpful staff, traded against no breakfast and the limited facilities you'd expect at this size · For a clean, distinctive overnight that won't cost much, it's a fitting choice.

faqTitle: FAQ — Le Blocs Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo

faq.q: Where is Le Blocs Aranyaprathet — is it near Rong Kluea Market?
faq.a: It's at 87 KM.2 Left Side Rd, Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo Province · about 3-4 km (roughly 10 minutes by car) from Rong Kluea Market and the Ban Khlong Luek crossing into Poipet · It sits between the town and the border market — if you don't have a car, the front desk can call a tuk-tuk.

faq.q: What are the starting prices and room types?
faq.a: Rooms start from about ฿750/night for a Standard (container) room · there's also a Superior at around ฿850 and a Deluxe at around ฿950 with more space · prices vary by date and demand, so compare a few platforms before booking.

Most reviews say the rooms are larger than expected, the air-con is cold, and they're clean, finished in bright modern tones · the bathroom has a shower and there's free Wi-Fi in every room · one thing to know: container walls don't block sound as well as concrete, so ask for an interior room if you're sensitive to noise.

faq.q: Is breakfast included — is there a cafe?
faq.a: There is no breakfast service, but there is an on-site cafe/restaurant for coffee or a light bite · the cafe keeps limited hours, so check opening times with the front desk or plan to eat in Aranyaprathet town.

faq.q: Is there parking — is it easy to self-drive?
faq.a: Yes, there's free parking and the property is right on the road into town · self-driving is easier than waiting for a tuk-tuk in this area, which makes it convenient for shoppers heading to Rong Kluea Market or anyone stopping over before the border.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits Rong Kluea Market shoppers, travellers crossing into Poipet, or anyone who wants a budget container-design stay · best for people who value a clean, distinctive bed over a full set of facilities like a larger hotel.
